verdict.rationale: The product is itself a set of agent-readable `SKILL.md` instruction files that you can paste into any chat to run as a mode, or install into `.claude/skills/`. That is agent-oriented markdown an agent can be pointed at directly. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt or dedicated agent-facing documentation, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a dedicated agent-oriented docs index or markdown docs endpoint, and independent corroboration of agents consuming the docs.
